class.name: OcgGceMakecylinder
class.brief_description: This class implements construction algorithms for `gp_Cylinder`. Supported constructions include: - cylinder from axis placement and radius; - cylinder coaxial to another, through point or at signed offset; - cylinder from three points; - cylinder from axis and radius; - cylinder from circular base.

method.name: from_1
method.description: Creates a cylinder from circular base.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a cylinder from axis placement and radius.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Creates a cylinder coaxial to input cylinder and passing through a point.

method.name: from_4
method.description: Creates a cylinder coaxial to input cylinder at signed distance.

method.name: from_5
method.description: Makes a Cylinder by its axis <Axis> and radius <Radius>.

method.name: from_6
method.description: Creates a cylinder from three points.

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns the constructed cylinder. Exceptions StdFail_NotDone if no cylinder is constructed.

method.name: Operator
method.description: Alias for Value() returning a copy.
